verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD . . . said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ־ אִשָּׁ֗ה כִּ֤י יַפְלִא֙ לִנְדֹּר֙ נֶ֣דֶר נָזִ֔יר לְהַזִּ֖יר לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ’îš ’ōw- ’iš·šāh kî yap̄·li lin·dōr ne·ḏer nā·zîr lə·haz·zîr Yah·weh
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and tell them that if a man or woman makes a special vow the vow of a Nazirite to separate himself to the LORD

verses.original: מִיַּ֤יִן וְשֵׁכָר֙ יַזִּ֔יר חֹ֥מֶץ יַ֛יִן וְחֹ֥מֶץ שֵׁכָ֖ר לֹ֣א יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה וְכָל־ מִשְׁרַ֤ת עֲנָבִים֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁתֶּ֔ה וַעֲנָבִ֛ים לַחִ֥ים וִיבֵשִׁ֖ים לֹ֥א יֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: mî·ya·yin wə·šê·ḵār yaz·zîr ḥō·meṣ ya·yin wə·ḥō·meṣ šê·ḵār lō yiš·teh wə·ḵāl miš·raṯ ‘ă·nā·ḇîm lō yiš·teh wa·‘ă·nā·ḇîm la·ḥîm wî·ḇê·šîm lō yō·ḵêl
verses.literal: he is to abstain from wine and strong drink He must not drink vinegar made from wine . . . or strong drink and he must not drink any grape juice or eat fresh grapes or raisins . . .

verses.original: כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֑וֹ מִכֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵעָשֶׂ֜ה מִגֶּ֣פֶן הַיַּ֗יִן מֵחַרְצַנִּ֛ים וְעַד־ זָ֖ג לֹ֥א יֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kōl yə·mê niz·rōw mik·kōl ’ă·šer yê·‘ā·śeh mig·ge·p̄en hay·ya·yin mê·ḥar·ṣan·nîm wə·‘aḏ- zāḡ lō yō·ḵêl
verses.literal: All the days of his separation he is not to eat anything that comes from the grapevine . . . not even the seeds or skins

verses.original: כָּל־ יְמֵי֙ נֶ֣דֶר נִזְר֔וֹ תַּ֖עַר לֹא־ יַעֲבֹ֣ר עַל־ רֹאשׁ֑וֹ עַד־ מְלֹ֨את הַיָּמִ֜ם אֲשֶׁר־ יַזִּ֤יר לַיהוָה֙ קָדֹ֣שׁ יִהְיֶ֔ה גַּדֵּ֥ל פֶּ֖רַע שְׂעַ֥ר רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- yə·mê ne·ḏer niz·rōw ta·‘ar lō- ya·‘ă·ḇōr ‘al- rō·šōw ‘aḏ- mə·lōṯ hay·yā·mim ’ă·šer- yaz·zîr Yah·weh qā·ḏōš yih·yeh gad·dêl pe·ra‘ śə·‘ar rō·šōw
verses.literal: For the entire period of his vow of separation no razor shall touch . . . his head He must be holy until the time of his separation to the LORD is complete he must let the hair of his head grow long

verses.original: כָּל־ יְמֵ֥י הַזִּיר֖וֹ לַיהוָ֑ה עַל־ נֶ֥פֶשׁ מֵ֖ת לֹ֥א יָבֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- yə·mê haz·zî·rōw Yah·weh ‘al- ne·p̄eš mêṯ lō yā·ḇō
verses.literal: Throughout the days of his separation to the LORD he must not go near a dead body

verses.original: לְאָבִ֣יו וּלְאִמּ֗וֹ לְאָחִיו֙ וּלְאַ֣חֹת֔וֹ לֹא־ יִטַּמָּ֥א לָהֶ֖ם בְּמֹתָ֑ם כִּ֛י נֵ֥זֶר אֱלֹהָ֖יו עַל־ רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·’ā·ḇîw ū·lə·’im·mōw lə·’ā·ḥîw ū·lə·’a·ḥō·ṯōw lō- yiṭ·ṭam·mā lā·hem bə·mō·ṯām kî nê·zer ’ĕ·lō·hāw ‘al- rō·šōw
verses.literal: Even if his father or mother or brother or sister should die he is not to defile himself because the symbol of consecration to his God is upon his head

verses.original: כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֑וֹ קָדֹ֥שׁ ה֖וּא לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōl yə·mê niz·rōw qā·ḏōš hū Yah·weh
verses.literal: Throughout the time . . . of his separation he is holy to the LORD

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יָמ֨וּת מֵ֤ת עָלָיו֙ בְּפֶ֣תַע פִּתְאֹ֔ם וְטִמֵּ֖א רֹ֣אשׁ נִזְר֑וֹ וְגִלַּ֤ח רֹאשׁוֹ֙ בְּי֣וֹם טָהֳרָת֔וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י יְגַלְּחֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yā·mūṯ mêṯ ‘ā·lāw bə·p̄e·ṯa‘ piṯ·’ōm wə·ṭim·mê rōš niz·rōw wə·ḡil·laḥ rō·šōw bə·yō·wm ṭā·ho·rā·ṯōw bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î yə·ḡal·lə·ḥen·nū
verses.literal: If someone suddenly . . . dies . . . in his presence and defiles his consecrated head of hair he must shave his head on the day of his cleansing the seventh day

verses.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י יָבִא֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·mî·nî yā·ḇi šə·tê ṯō·rîm ’ōw šə·nê bə·nê yō·w·nāh ’el- hak·kō·hên ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: On the eighth day he must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן אֶחָ֤ד לְחַטָּאת֙ וְאֶחָ֣ד לְעֹלָ֔ה וְכִפֶּ֣ר עָלָ֔יו מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖א עַל־ הַנָּ֑פֶשׁ וְקִדַּ֥שׁ אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֖וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śāh hak·kō·hên ’e·ḥāḏ lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·’e·ḥāḏ lə·‘ō·lāh wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·lāw mê·’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā ‘al- han·nā·p̄eš wə·qid·daš ’eṯ- rō·šōw bay·yō·wm ha·hū
verses.literal: And the priest is to offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to make atonement for him because he has sinned by being in the presence of the dead body On that day he must consecrate his head again

verses.original: וְהִזִּ֤יר לַֽיהוָה֙ אֶת־ יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֔וֹ וְהֵבִ֛יא כֶּ֥בֶשׂ בֶּן־ שְׁנָת֖וֹ לְאָשָׁ֑ם וְהַיָּמִ֤ים הָרִאשֹׁנִים֙ יִפְּל֔וּ כִּ֥י טָמֵ֖א נִזְרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiz·zîr Yah·weh ’eṯ- yə·mê niz·rōw wə·hê·ḇî ke·ḇeś ben- šə·nā·ṯōw lə·’ā·šām wə·hay·yā·mîm hā·ri·šō·nîm yip·pə·lū kî ṭā·mê niz·rōw
verses.literal: He must rededicate his time of separation to the LORD and bring a year-old . . . male lamb as a guilt offering But the preceding days shall not be counted because his separation was defiled

verses.original: וְזֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַנָּזִ֑יר בְּי֗וֹם מְלֹאת֙ יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֔וֹ יָבִ֣יא אֹת֔וֹ אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zōṯ tō·w·raṯ han·nā·zîr bə·yō·wm mə·lōṯ yə·mê niz·rōw yā·ḇî ’ō·ṯōw ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Now this is the law of the Nazirite when his time of separation is complete He must be brought to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֣יב אֶת־ קָרְבָּנ֣וֹ לַיהוָ֡ה כֶּבֶשׂ֩ בֶּן־ שְׁנָת֨וֹ תָמִ֤ים אֶחָד֙ לְעֹלָ֔ה וְכַבְשָׂ֨ה אַחַ֧ת בַּת־ שְׁנָתָ֛הּ תְּמִימָ֖ה לְחַטָּ֑את וְאַֽיִל־ אֶחָ֥ד תָּמִ֖ים לִשְׁלָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·rîḇ ’eṯ- qā·rə·bā·nōw Yah·weh ke·ḇeś ben- šə·nā·ṯōw ṯā·mîm ’e·ḥāḏ lə·‘ō·lāh wə·ḵaḇ·śāh ’a·ḥaṯ baṯ- šə·nā·ṯāh tə·mî·māh lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·’a·yil- ’e·ḥāḏ tā·mîm liš·lā·mîm
verses.literal: and he is to present an offering to the LORD of an unblemished year-old . . . male lamb as a burnt offering an unblemished year-old . . . female lamb as a sin offering and an unblemished ram as a peace offering

verses.original: וְסַ֣ל מַצּ֗וֹת סֹ֤לֶת חַלֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֣ים בַּשָּׁ֑מֶן וּמִנְחָתָ֖ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·sal maṣ·ṣō·wṯ sō·leṯ ḥal·lōṯ bə·lū·lōṯ baš·še·men ū·rə·qî·qê maṣ·ṣō·wṯ mə·šu·ḥîm baš·šā·men ū·min·ḥā·ṯām wə·nis·kê·hem
verses.literal: together with their grain offerings and drink offerings and a basket of unleavened cakes made from fine flour mixed with oil and unleavened wafers coated with oil

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֥יב הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְעָשָׂ֥ה אֶת־ חַטָּאת֖וֹ וְאֶת־ עֹלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·rîḇ hak·kō·hên lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·‘ā·śāh ’eṯ- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- ‘ō·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: The priest is to present all these before the LORD and make the sin offering and the burnt offering

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הָאַ֜יִל יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה זֶ֤בַח שְׁלָמִים֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה עַ֖ל סַ֣ל הַמַּצּ֑וֹת וְעָשָׂה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶת־ מִנְחָת֖וֹ וְאֶת־ נִסְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hā·’a·yil ya·‘ă·śeh ze·ḇaḥ šə·lā·mîm Yah·weh ‘al sal ham·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ wə·‘ā·śāh hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- min·ḥā·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- nis·kōw
verses.literal: He shall also offer the ram as a peace offering to the LORD along with the basket of unleavened bread And the priest is to offer the accompanying grain offering and drink offering

verses.original: וְגִלַּ֣ח הַנָּזִ֗יר פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד אֶת־ רֹ֣אשׁ נִזְר֑וֹ וְלָקַ֗ח אֶת־ שְׂעַר֙ רֹ֣אשׁ נִזְר֔וֹ וְנָתַן֙ עַל־ הָאֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁר־ תַּ֖חַת זֶ֥בַח הַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡil·laḥ han·nā·zîr pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ’eṯ- rōš niz·rōw wə·lā·qaḥ ’eṯ- śə·‘ar rōš niz·rōw wə·nā·ṯan ‘al- hā·’êš ’ă·šer- ta·ḥaṯ ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm
verses.literal: Then at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting the Nazirite is to shave his consecrated head take the hair - and put it on the fire under the peace offering

verses.original: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ הַזְּרֹ֣עַ בְּשֵׁלָה֮ מִן־ הָאַיִל֒ וְֽחַלַּ֨ת מַצָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ מִן־ הַסַּ֔ל וּרְקִ֥יק מַצָּ֖ה אֶחָ֑ד וְנָתַן֙ עַל־ כַּפֵּ֣י הַנָּזִ֔יר אַחַ֖ר הִֽתְגַּלְּח֥וֹ אֶת־ נִזְרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- haz·zə·rō·a‘ bə·šê·lāh min- hā·’a·yil wə·ḥal·laṯ maṣ·ṣāh ’a·ḥaṯ min- has·sal ū·rə·qîq maṣ·ṣāh ’e·ḥāḏ wə·nā·ṯan ‘al- kap·pê han·nā·zîr ’a·ḥar hiṯ·gal·lə·ḥōw ’eṯ- niz·rōw
verses.literal: And the priest is to take the boiled shoulder from the ram one unleavened cake from the basket and one unleavened wafer and put them into the hands of the Nazirite who has just shaved the hair of his consecration

verses.original: וְהֵנִיף֩ אוֹתָ֨ם הַכֹּהֵ֥ן׀ תְּנוּפָה֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ קֹ֤דֶשׁ הוּא֙ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן עַ֚ל חֲזֵ֣ה הַתְּנוּפָ֔ה וְעַ֖ל שׁ֣וֹק הַתְּרוּמָ֑ה וְאַחַ֛ר יִשְׁתֶּ֥ה הַנָּזִ֖יר יָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·nîp̄ ’ō·w·ṯām hak·kō·hên tə·nū·p̄āh lip̄·nê Yah·weh qō·ḏeš hū lak·kō·hên ‘al ḥă·zêh hat·tə·nū·p̄āh wə·‘al šō·wq hat·tə·rū·māh wə·’a·ḥar yiš·teh han·nā·zîr yā·yin
verses.literal: The priest shall then wave them as a wave offering before the LORD This is a holy portion for the priest in addition to the breast of the wave offering . . . and the thigh that was presented After that the Nazirite may drink wine

verses.original: זֹ֣את תּוֹרַ֣ת הַנָּזִיר֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִדֹּר֒ קָרְבָּנ֤וֹ לַֽיהוָה֙ עַל־ נִזְר֔וֹ מִלְּבַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר־ תַּשִּׂ֣יג יָד֑וֹ כְּפִ֤י נִדְרוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִדֹּ֔ר כֵּ֣ן יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה עַ֖ל תּוֹרַ֥ת נִזְרֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: zōṯ tō·w·raṯ han·nā·zîr ’ă·šer yid·dōr qā·rə·bā·nōw Yah·weh ‘al- niz·rōw mil·lə·ḇaḏ ’ă·šer- taś·śîḡ yā·ḏōw kə·p̄î niḏ·rōw ’ă·šer yid·dōr kên ya·‘ă·śeh ‘al tō·w·raṯ niz·rōw
verses.literal: This is the law of the Nazirite who vows his offering to the LORD for his separation in addition to whatever else he can afford . . . . . . he must fulfill whatever vow he makes according to the law of his separation

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֤ר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶל־ בָּנָ֣יו לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֥ה תְבָרֲכ֖וּ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אָמ֖וֹר לָהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’el- bā·nāw lê·mōr kōh ṯə·ḇā·ră·ḵū ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·mō·wr lā·hem
verses.literal: Tell . . . Aaron . . . and his sons This is how you are to bless the Israelites . . . Say to them

verses.original: יְבָרֶכְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה וְיִשְׁמְרֶֽךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: yə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā Yah·weh wə·yiš·mə·re·ḵā
verses.literal: May the LORD bless you and keep you

verses.original: יָאֵ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה׀ פָּנָ֛יו אֵלֶ֖יךָ וִֽיחֻנֶּֽךָּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: yā·’êr Yah·weh pā·nāw ’ê·le·ḵā wî·ḥun·ne·kā
verses.literal: may the LORD cause His face to shine upon you and be gracious to you

verses.original: יִשָּׂ֨א יְהוָ֤ה׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃ס
verses.transliteration: yiś·śā Yah·weh pā·nāw ’ê·le·ḵā wə·yā·śêm lə·ḵā šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and give you peace

verses.original: וְשָׂמ֥וּ אֶת־ שְׁמִ֖י עַל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַאֲנִ֖י אֲבָרֲכֵֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·śā·mū ’eṯ- šə·mî ‘al- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wa·’ă·nî ’ă·ḇā·ră·ḵêm
verses.literal: So they shall put My name on the Israelites . . . and I will bless them
